notes: The PDF's inventory pages were not included, so true Element IDs are unknown. Catalogue types were chosen by visual match, and new descriptive lego-* types were created for pieces with no catalogue match.

Chassis: steps 1-2 show two black plates with wheel pins, modelled as two lego-plate-wheelholder pieces joined through the grey clip plate. That plate and the bin tray each have two anti-stud ports so each port is used once.
The steering wheel was changed from lego-9551 to a new type lego-3829, a best guess at the real part number. It could not be checked against the missing inventory pages.
Stud and port assignments on b1/b2/b9/b10 are approximate because the isometric pictures don't show which exact studs are used.
Step 13 shows the same model as step 12 with the grey rod in place; no extra part was identified. The black bristles seen in the picture are not modelled as separate parts.

Step 14 shows dark brown round plates (rubbish) in the bin, modelled as two 1x1 round plates. The broom/shovel is modelled as one tool clipped to the side-clip brick; in step 15 the minifigure holds it, with no edge for that.
Minifigure legs are placed on the chassis seat position in step 15. The wheel copies attach to the four wheel pins (two on each chassis plate).
